name: Festlige Terninger Østervang 2024

venue.name: Østervangsskolen
venue.details: Festsalen. Gå ind ad hovedindgangen (ved Kirken / Coop) og til højre

information:
Denne konkurrence vil have Face Turning Octahedron (FTO) som en "fun event" lørdag eftermiddag. Deltagere skal selv medbringe deres FTO puzzle. Resultater vil blive sendt til https://cubingcontests.com.

This competition will have Face Turning Octahedron (FTO) as a fun event saturday afternoon. Participants should bring their own FTO puzzle. Results will be posted to https://cubingcontests.com.
